Imagine putting a grape cut almost in half into the microwave.
Seconds later it shoots out a glowing ball of fire.
But it's not fire. It's plasma. The same stuff in lightning and the sun.
For about twenty five years people said the strip of skin worked like a tiny antenna.
So scientists in Canada spent years zapping grapes to find out.
They wrecked twelve microwaves doing it.
But two whole grapes touching sparked just the same.
So did tiny balls of almost pure water.
Inside water microwaves shrink to about the size of a grape. So each ball traps them inside.
Where two balls touch all that energy gets crammed into one tiny spot.
It gets so strong it rips atoms apart into glowing plasma.
The skin was never the secret. It was the water all along.
Just don't try it unless you want a hole melted in your microwave.
